purpose: Cross-check the user's newly expanded wiki lore against in-game text; research only, no changes to graph content.

coverage.versionScope: 3.8 first; older text searched for corroboration when needed
coverage.substringHandling: Whole-word/phrase filtering applied before interpreting proper-name hits
coverage.limitations: Some older searches are capped at 50 rows. Absence from the checked results is not proof of absence from the game.

findings.finding: The terminology entry names Dr. Scott Rabelle as the developer of the Resonator examination method. Lily's 3.8 voice line and story identify Professor Rabelle as her medical teacher at Clotho.
findings.qualification: The full name comes from older text; the 3.8 passages use Professor Rabelle. Treat the wiki's identification as a cross-source link, rather than claiming the full name first appears in 3.8.

evidence.excerpt:
Developed by Dr. Scott Rabelle, this method was originally designed to examine Resonators. It is also known as "Rabelle's Test."
Known for its safety, reliability, and ease of use, the test has since been adopted across multiple regions.

Professor Rabelle was one of my most important teachers back at the Clotho Doctors Alliance. He taught me more than just medicine. He taught me what it truly means to be a healer. That all we can do is give every last bit of ourselves to save every life we can. And trust that will be enough.

Lily began her internship at the Clotho Doctors Alliance on her birthday.
There were no flowers, no cake, nobody from home. What welcomed her was the smell of disinfectant, which hung in those corridors all year and never thinned.
"New, are you? Right, then. Down to the laundry."
Sheets, blankets and pillowcases stiff with dried blood, heaped up and waiting

findings.qualification: These support membership and training links. Professor Rabelle's presence alone does not independently prove the wiki's claim that he headed the company.

findings.topic: Novialle Regenerative Group / Ichor / Luuk Herssen
findings.finding: The terminology entries define Novialle as a New Federation pharmaceutical corporation and Ichor as a controversial treatment with severe side effects. Luuk describes its Golden Serum and his inheritance of the company.
findings.qualification: These are 3.1 sources, useful for the newly expanded wiki context but not new 3.8 revelations. Keep Ichor's lore entry separate from combat-resource labels such as Ichor Flow and Ichor Blade.

evidence.excerpt: A pharmaceutical corporation based in the New Federation. Its core technology originates from the development of Ichor, a groundbreaking medical advancement shadowed by perpetual controversy.

A special pharmaceutical substance developed for extremely rare diseases. However, its severe side effects make it intolerable for most, keeping it under ongoing research and validation. In its natural form, Ichor is a volatile golden liquid that radiates intense heat at room temperature. In rare cases, it can be controlled and stabilized into a solid form.
The "Golden Serum" developed by the Novialle Group. But I prefer its other name—Ichor.

findings.topic: War sides in the wiki overview
findings.finding: A 3.8 war report describes fighting between the Federated Cities' government forces and a Resonator army. Its Chinese wording also distinguishes those two forces. This needs reconciliation with the wiki overview identifying the Federated Army with the Resonator front.
findings.qualification: The report is an in-world journalistic account, not a complete history of every faction. Flag the apparent tension rather than reversing the entire war chronology on one document.
